name: Atexxo Zone 2 iPhone 16 Pro Max
summary: The Atexxo Zone 2 iPhone 16 Pro Max is a standard Apple iPhone 16 Pro Max converted by Atexxo for hazardous areas, certified for Zone 2/22 under ATEX. It combines increased safety and intrinsic safety (Ex ec ic). The phone runs iOS 27.

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ec ic IIC T4 Gc / II 3D Ex tc IIIB T135°C Dc
atex.scope: Unit assessment: each unit is checked by a notified body. No certificate number is published.

certification.protection: Increased safety and intrinsic safety (Ex ec ic)

safety.conditions: Charge in safe area (wired USB-C or wireless). Each unit spark-tested for intrinsically safe circuits (according to the maker's flyer).

specs.camera: 48 MP Fusion + 48 MP ultra wide + 12 MP 5x telephoto
specs.batteryLife: Up to 33 hours of video playback
specs.wirelessCharging: MagSafe up to 25 W; Qi up to 7.5 W
specs.nfc: Yes (Apple Pay + Core NFC tag reading)
specs.gnss: GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS, BeiDou, NavIC
specs.keys: Action Button; Camera Control; side; volume
specs.satellite: Emergency SOS + Roadside Assistance via satellite (region-dependent)

throughCase.label: USB-C / Lightning port
throughCase.value: Wired charging via housing (USB-C; Lightning on iPhone 14 models)

capabilities.label: Push-to-talk
capabilities.value: Via app (Push to Talk framework); Action Button mappable if accessible

capabilities.label: Barcode scanning
capabilities.value: Built in (QR via Camera) / Via app (1D/2D)

capabilities.label: NFC reading
capabilities.value: Built in (Core NFC); through-case use not stated

capabilities.label: Satellite SOS
capabilities.value: Built in on iPhone; not verified through enclosure

unconfirmed.os.securityUntil: Estimated from Apple's minimum commitment of five years from first sale. Apple usually supports iPhones for longer.
unconfirmed.specs.ram: Apple doesn't publish RAM. This is the widely reported figure.
unconfirmed.specs.battery: Apple doesn't publish battery capacity. Figure from regulatory filings and teardowns.
unconfirmed.specs.wirelessCharging: As listed on Apple's tech specs, which don't mention Qi2.
unconfirmed.specs.satellite: Listed on Apple's tech specs; availability depends on the country.

strengths: A standard Apple iPhone 16 Pro Max inside, with the same apps and Apple device management as other iPhones
limitations: Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
Dust group IIIB: not rated for conductive dust
Certified by ATEX unit assessment; no certificate number is published
